resume: Chord harp inspired by the Omnichord: the 16 white keys are the strum plate, the 11 black keys the chord buttons. Behind them, an organ chord with its bass and ten rhythms from the OM-84.

commandes.role: Lowers the strum plate by one octave.
Raises the strum plate by one octave.
Sound page: Reverb, Space, Width, Chord rev.
Chords page: press a black key, then KNOB 1 (Root) and KNOB 2 (Type) change its chord.
Held with a black key: the minor chord. With LFO at the same time: m7.
Held with a black key: the seventh.
Switches from one page to the next.
Setup page: Tune, MIDI out, Lights.
Play page: Voice 1, Voice 2, Sustain, Chord level.
Saves; FoMni also saves by itself a few seconds after a change.
CHORD HOLD: the chord keeps sounding after release (pressing the same key again stops it).
Rhythm page: Rhythm, Tempo, Drums level, Auto bass.
SYNC START: the rhythm waits for your first chord.
Strum plate: each key plucks a string of the chord, in groups of three (root, third, fifth) within an F# to F window.
Chord buttons (default F, C, G, D minor, A minor, E minor, G7, E7, D7, B flat, A7).

gestes: ENV held + black key: minor chord; LFO held: seventh; both: m7.
a_savoir: Each page puts four values on KNOB 1 to 4.
MIDI comes in over USB and the TRS jack, and goes out over USB.
